highlights: The AI landscape is seeing a strong push towards specialized and efficient open-source models, enabling on-device and local execution for applications in speech and coding agents.
Significant progress has been made in enhancing the reliability and functionality of AI agents, with new tools for crash-proofing, automated state management, and efficient knowledge transfer.
Major partnerships and enterprise-wide adoptions are broadening access to frontier AI models and demonstrating their tangible impact across diverse sectors, from legal workflows to life sciences.

agents.title: Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents
agents.summary: Vercel has released 'durable-harness,' an open-source package designed to make coding agent sessions resilient to crashes, timeouts, and redeploys by logging all model and tool calls for seamless resumption.

agents.title: Automating Backup in Coding Agents with 'BackUpper'
agents.summary: A new framework, 'RegretBench' and 'BackUpper,' addresses the lack of backup awareness in coding agents by automating state preservation before critical modifications, ensuring reversibility and reducing operational regret at low cost.

agents.title: D-Skill: Distilling Teacher Knowledge through Agent Skills
agents.summary: D-Skill is a novel framework that distills complex behavioral advantages from black-box teacher agents into interpretable, natural-language skills for smaller student models, closing performance gaps efficiently without weight updates or extra environment interaction.

models.title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK
models.summary: Mistral AI has launched Voxtral 3, a comprehensive suite including advanced transcription models, a text-to-speech model, and a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK, enabling high-accuracy speech applications and conversational agents.

models.title: Recursive Releases Flint, a 40B MoE Open-Weight Local Coding Model for Agents
models.summary: Recursive introduced Flint, an Apache 2.0 licensed open-weight coding model with 40B parameters (2.5B active) optimized for local execution, reporting high performance on SWE-bench Verified and fast token generation on consumer hardware.

models.title: IBM AI Releases Granite Speech 5.0 2B for Multilingual Transcription and Translation
models.summary: IBM has released Granite Speech 5.0 2B, an Apache 2.0 model for multilingual speech recognition and translation, achieving top performance on the Open ASR Leaderboard with significant accuracy for developers building global speech applications.

tools.title: OpenAI Models Coming to Google Cloud
tools.summary: OpenAI and Google Cloud are partnering to make frontier models and Codex workflows accessible in Gemini’s Model Garden, expanding the reach of OpenAI's advanced AI capabilities to developers on Google Cloud Marketplace.

tools.title: Hugging Face Integrates Native TPU Support with TorchTPU
tools.summary: Hugging Face now natively supports TPUs through TorchTPU, enabling developers to more easily leverage Google's Tensor Processing Units for training and inference with Hugging Face models, streamlining infrastructure management.

tools.title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
tools.summary: DiffResearch is an open, multi-agent framework that utilizes diffusion language models to significantly reduce end-to-end latency in deep research systems, offering a 6x speedup over autoregressive backbones in planning and writing.

companies.title: OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio to Expand into Life Sciences R&D
companies.summary: OpenAI has acquired Orchestra Bio to integrate AI-powered operations into life sciences research and development, aiming to accelerate drug discovery and advance new treatments by enhancing biopharma teams' capabilities.

companies.title: Uber Rolls Out ChatGPT Work to All Employees with OpenAI
companies.summary: Uber is deploying ChatGPT Work to over 30,000 employees globally, empowering teams to enhance productivity across research, data analysis, presentation creation, and complex workflow automation.

companies.title: Cloudflare Enhances Cybersecurity and Code Quality with OpenAI
companies.summary: Cloudflare is leveraging OpenAI Daybreak to investigate vulnerabilities and propose fixes, while also using Codex to accelerate developer workflows and improve code quality, strengthening its defense posture and development efficiency.

learning.title: NVIDIA Nsight Python Tutorial: How to Profile GPU Kernels
learning.summary: This tutorial introduces NVIDIA Nsight Python, an open-source interface allowing developers to profile GPU kernels, analyze hardware metrics, and evaluate performance directly from Python code for optimized AI/ML workloads.

learning.title: Developer’s Guide to OmniParseBench: Benchmarks and OCR Testing
learning.summary: A comprehensive developer's guide to OmniParseBench demonstrates how to audit, rebuild, and test parser ranking certainty and OCR performance, offering practical insights for evaluating document parsing solutions like Tesseract and Indra.

learning.title: DevFest 2026 Returns with Focus on Agentic AI Era
learning.summary: DevFest 2026 is back, offering over 800 global events for developers to connect, build, secure, and scale their projects, with a strong emphasis on mastering the tools and techniques of the agentic AI era.
